userDescription: Governed semantic model for Contoso Capital portfolio value management. Each measure is bound to one term in the business glossary.
dataSourceInstructions: Answer with the model's measures (Revenue, Plan Revenue, EBITDA, Plan EBITDA, EBITDA vs Plan %, EBITDA Margin %, LTM EBITDA, Net Debt, Leverage x, Initiative Target Uplift). Filter companies by companies[company_name].
